tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/tiktok-live-setup.ts — a TikTok LIVE stream initialization and validation script. Checks: TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN env var, TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY, TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET. Simulates live setup in dry-run mode when token is missing (no real API calls). Outputs JSON report to reports/tiktok-live-setup.json with fields: { generated_at, token_valid, client_creds_present, dry_run, checks: [{name, pass, detail}], next_steps }. Must import dotenv, fs, path from stdlib only — no external npm packages. Use dotenv with config({ path: join(ROOT, '.env') }). Print a human-readable summary to stdout. Exit 0 on pass, exit 1 if critical checks fail.
tasks.context: TikTok LIVE is a separate flow from regular posting. TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is not yet set in .env (live posting blocked). This script validates readiness and produces a setup report so operator knows exactly what is needed when token is obtained. No real TikTok API calls — validation only.
